title: MLCC Train Technique Manifest
description: Schema for an optional do/training/<technique>/manifest.json (BL154). Describes a do/train technique's hyperparameter knobs as METADATA (type, bounds, enum, tier, control, help text); per-knob VALUES stay in the technique's defaults.yaml. The knob entry contract is the tune descriptor's $defs/hyperparameter (one knob contract shared with do/tune). No _synced layer, reward_source, or dataset_contract (post-v2).

$schema.description: Optional editor hint (e.g. "../manifest.schema.json"). Ignored by do/train.

schema_version.description: Manifest format version. Only 1 is defined.

technique.description: Technique id. Must equal the do/training/<technique>/ directory name.

hyperparameters.description: Knob name -> knob entry. Knob names are the keys train.py reads from its hyperparameters.

hyperparameter.description: One synced knob. `type` and `required` are ALWAYS present (so the do/tune consumer can enforce required-knob behavior and type validation). `default` is OPTIONAL — a required knob may legitimately have none, in which case the builder prompts for it. `control` and `tier` are OPTIONAL — the leaner MTRL override-params omit them, and the do/tune builder DERIVES them when absent (enum -> dropdown, min/max -> number_input, else text_input; default tier primary). The canonical key names are `control` (synced from the override-param `control_type`) and `tier` (from `visibility_tier`); the sync does the rename.

type.description: The knob's value type (from the override-param `type`).

required.description: Whether the knob must have a value. Defaults to false when the override-param omits it.

default.description: The knob's default value, when the override-param provides one. Type matches `type`. Absent when the source carries no default.

min.description: Inclusive lower bound for a numeric knob, where the source declares one.

max.description: Inclusive upper bound for a numeric knob, where the source declares one.

step.description: Numeric step, where the source declares one.

enum.description: The allowed choice-list, where the source declares one (drives a dropdown).

control.description: The input widget (synced from the override-param `control_type`). OPTIONAL; the builder derives it when absent.

tier.description: Progressive-disclosure tier (synced from the override-param `visibility_tier`). OPTIONAL; the builder derives `primary` when absent.

display_name.description: Human-readable label (where the source declares one).

description.description: One-line help text (where the source declares one).

hint.description: Short input hint (where the source declares one).
